remarks: Looking for a spacious, charming, and renovated place to live in the Cove neighborhood of Stamford? Look no further. This 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath home features quartz countertops, brand new stainless steel appliances, hardwood floors, and an ensuite primary suite with tall ceilings and walk-in closet. The main level of this home has a living room, dining room, sun room, laundry room, and a powder room. On the living level, this home features an additional bonus room that can be used as an office, studio, etc. Two off street parking spaces included included. Landlord covers water/ sewer, lawn, snow, and trash. Good credit, income, background check, and application required.
